recursive.notes: Recursive Superintelligence (Richard Socher, Tim Rocktäschel and six co-founders), building self-improving AI. Entry round left null: the only disclosed financing is the USD 650M round led by GV and Greycroft and no source places Earlybird in it; the firm's 'Seed' label is unverified (searched: Google News "Recursive Superintelligence" Earlybird -> 0 items; "Recursive" Socher Earlybird -> no item naming Earlybird; one web search; EDGAR shows only a third-party SPV Form D of 2026-04-24; the UK company, incorporated 2025-12-31, has no share allotments on file).
